# Host operations appendix — fictional snapshot

Source identity: `https://docs.relaymesh.invalid/operations/host-volumes`; body captured successfully on 2026-11-04.

This generic operations appendix recommends encrypting VM host volumes and database disks using the customer's operating-system and cloud controls. It contains no RelayMesh configuration setting and applies equally to unrelated applications.

This is different from the product's own [device identity state protection](sealed-state.md).
